sights.n: Niseko Goshiki Onsen (ニセコ五色温泉)
sights.address: Between the Niseko Annupuri and Iwaonupuri trailheads, Niseko mountains, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A 1930 mountain hot spring at 750 m, smelling of sulphur, whose free-flowing water shifts from clear to milky white — hence 'five colours'.

sights.n: Niseko Yumoto Onsen & Ōyunuma (ニセコ湯本温泉・大湯沼)
sights.address: Foot of Mt Chisenupuri, Niseko mountains, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: At the foot of Chisenupuri — a bubbling mud-sulphur pond where you watch the hot spring welling up, with onsen lodges around it.
